@copilot Update this PR directly with a behavior-preserving cleanup of redundant unresolved-address filtering.

The shared InternalNetworkAttributesExtractor already emits network.peer.port only when network.peer.address is non-null, and applies the same condition to local address/port. SocketAddressUtil.getAddress returns null for an unresolved InetSocketAddress. A getter returning its known port does not mean that port is emitted. Keep those existing infrastructure contracts unchanged; do not add another utility, flag, or public API.

Remove the unresolved-Inet-only ternaries from getNetworkPeerSocketAddress in LettuceDbAttributesGetter and LettuceBatchAttributesGetter in both lettuce-4.0 and lettuce-5.0, and in SpymemcachedAttributesGetter in spymemcached-2.12. Return the existing raw peer directly and remove imports/locals that become unused.

The same redundant filtering remains in the Cassandra 4.0 and 4.4 CassandraSqlAttributesGetter coordinator fallbacks. Remove only their unresolved-address rejection. Preserve the supported-default-endpoint guards, existing endpoint type checks, captured-peer precedence, null handling, and no-DNS behavior. Audit the other getters changed by this PR for equivalent emission-only filtering and simplify it if redundant for the same verified reason.

Do not remove unresolved/type guards from peer selection or capture helpers merely because they look similar: those may control fallback, batch selection, or safe later dereferences. In particular leave the pre-existing couchbase-common-3.1 CouchbaseRequestPeers guard alone: consume later dereferences remoteAddress.getAddress(). Preserve all address-capture timing, retry and batch rules, logical server.address/server.port identity, Unix support, and external API compatibility.

Update directly affected getter tests to expect raw unresolved peers where appropriate. Verify actual extraction still omits both peer address and peer port for unresolved Inet peers, and retains resolved/Unix behavior. If this shared emission invariant lacks coverage, add one focused case in the existing central NetworkAttributesExtractorTest covering local and peer port-only getter results, rather than duplicating an extraction matrix in every adapter. Keep the existing known-port behavior of the raw port getters. Run the narrow relevant formatting and tests.

The stack is #21313, #21327, this PR #21328, then #21330. Make only this cleanup on this PR's existing head. Preserve its base and native stack membership; do not merge, rebase, modify another branch, or create another PR.

replies.body: Applied in `9e758a0c`. Removed redundant unresolved-address filtering, preserved the Cassandra fallback guards, and added coverage for raw unresolved peers and port-only extraction. Targeted tests and Spotless checks passed; CodeQL timed out.

@copilot Update this PR directly to fix the verified validation-only allocation regression identified in review https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/21328#pullrequestreview-5945127573, as a focused continuation of the socket-address cleanup.

The migration replaced cheap Internet-peer validity checks with SocketAddressUtil.getAddress(...), which delegates to InetSocketAddressUtil.getIpAddress and calls InetAddress.getHostAddress. Four capture-time guards now format and discard a numeric-IP string on the normal resolved-Inet path: JedisRequest.capturePeerAddress in jedis-2.0; CassandraChannel.getRemoteAddress in cassandra-4.0 and cassandra-4.4; and OpenTelemetryCallUtil.setNetworkPeer in hbase-client-common-1.0.

Retain an allocation-free InetSocketAddress validity check in those four paths, using isUnresolved or getAddress nullness as appropriate. Use shared decoding only for other socket types. Preserve exactly which raw peers are accepted, including null, unresolved Inet, unsupported addresses, empty Unix paths, and supported non-empty Unix peers. Keep raw SocketAddress identity, capture timing, captured-peer precedence, connection checks, retry and batch selection, and logical server identity unchanged. In HBase, avoid decoding a peer when there is no associated RequestAndContext. Keep this small; do not introduce a shared helper, public API, configuration, dependency, or benchmark.

Do not restore any of the seven emission-only getter guards removed in commit 9e758a0c. Cassandra coordinator fallback getters and Lettuce/Spymemcached getters must continue returning their raw unresolved peers, since the unchanged shared extractor already omits ports without addresses. The capture/selection guards above have a different role and must not be deleted.

Run the narrow relevant formatting and existing Jedis, Cassandra 4.0/4.4, and HBase capture/network tests. Add focused regression coverage, preferably in those existing tests, that would catch formatting a resolved InetAddress solely during capture if feasible with the current fixtures. Preserve their unresolved/unsupported rejection and Unix acceptance coverage; do not add a duplicate extraction matrix.

Make only this correction on this PR's existing head. Preserve base trask-socket-getters-http-rpc, draft state, and native stack membership. Do not merge, rebase, modify another branch, or create another PR.

@copilot Update this existing PR directly to fix Netty Unix-domain socket peer extraction in Redisson and preserve the Lettuce Unix-socket behavior affected by this migration.

The verified target is open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation PR #21328, head repository open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation, head branch trask-socket-getters-database-cache, baseline 1d01b5078e359cbb7d6b16459560b0e15eff1fe3. Keep the branch assigned by GitHub Copilot cloud agent. Do not rename it or create a replacement branch; retain any platform-assigned follow-up branch if GitHub creates one. CI run 44580979095 repeatedly fails :instrumentation:redisson:redisson-3.17:javaagent:redisson344Test in RedissonUnixSocketTest.commandUsesTheUnixSocketPeer(Path), both in regular Java 8/21 jobs and latest-dependencies CI. The expected network.peer.address is the actual /tmp/junit-.../redis.sock path, but the exported attribute is null. The new socket getter returns Netty io.netty.channel.unix.DomainSocketAddress directly; NetworkAttributesGetter delegates to SocketAddressUtil, which understands InetSocketAddress, the internal UnixSocketAddress wrapper, and JDK UnixDomainSocketAddress, not Netty's address.

Trace both Redisson instrumentation entrypoints, their common getter/request, and Lettuce 4.0, 5.0, and 5.1 getter/batch paths affected by this PR. LettuceCommandPeer previously extracted Netty DomainSocketAddress.path(), and that implementation was removed in the migration. Preserve that supported Unix peer telemetry with appropriate adaptation instead of weakening assertions or treating Netty addresses as unsupported. Reuse an existing appropriate adapter/helper if present and keep optional native transport compatibility across the supported library versions. Preserve Inet behavior, unresolved-peer omission, logical server identity, and module-owned raw peer capture, handoff, retries, and lifetime semantics.

Keep the existing real installed-agent Redisson Unix-socket test and its exact expected attributes, including the actual socket path and absent peer/server ports; do not skip it or change expectations to hide the failure. Add or adjust only focused regression coverage for the Netty adaptation and Lettuce paths that need it. Run the narrowest relevant spotlessApply directly before behavioral validation, then focused tests including the real Redisson UDS case on Linux and affected Lettuce cases.
